investment_theses.thesis: Semiconductor capex intensity favors AI-agnostic memory (MU, SK Hynix) over GPU specialists (NVDA) as cycle matures and hyperscaler efficiency focus tightens.
supporting_signals: CNBC: 'As AI becomes more fractured, one name stands out: AMD' — signals GPU overcapacity
JPMorgan: 'An AI label alone no longer wins lenders' — implies margin compression on pure-play AI capex
CNBC: 'Microsoft offers voluntary buyouts... AI leads to efficiency push' — efficiency trumps raw capex growth
investment_theses.counter_view: Meta + NVIDIA partnership deepens moat; $95B capex cycle still has 18+ months runway; GPU shortage may re-emerge in H2 2026.
investment_theses.expression: Long MU (Micron Technology) or SK Hynix ADR; short NVDA or underweight via QQQ vs SMH (semiconductor ETF)
